detail.longDescription: After I updated my Mac to macOS 27, the following code no longer results in visible checkboxes for all items: from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QListWidget, QListWidgetItem from PySide6.QtCore import Qt app = QApplication([]) list_widget = QListWidget() # Create items with checkboxes for i in range(5): item = QListWidgetItem(f"Item {i + 1}") item.setFlags(item.flags() | Qt.ItemIsUserCheckable) # Enable checkable item.setCheckState(Qt.Checked) # Set initial state list_widget.addItem(item) list_widget.show() app.exec() Now, as shown below, only the first item in the list shows the checkbox. The above code put a checkbox for each item when run on macOS 26. My system is up to date on all packages and is running Python 3.14.0. Am I missing something, or was a bug introduced by the macOS upgrade to 27?
